title: The two components of the diagonal Kummer class
statement: Let $N>0$, let $A$ be a finite commutative ring annihilated by $N$, and let $S$ be any scheme on which $N$ is invertible. Put $P=\mathbf P^1_S$, $W=P\times_SP$ and let $\Delta:P\to W$ be its diagonal [def-nagata-projective-space-base-change, def-pc-fibre-product]. Use any normalized finite twist transport [def-asd-ordinary-finite-p1-arrows] and any relative hyperplane morphism $c:A_{\mathbf P^1_P}\to A_{\mathbf P^1_P}(1)[2]$ satisfying the actual scalar Kummer specification [def-asd-ordinary-finite-p1-kummer-class]. Then the diagonal ideal is invertible [def-nagata-effective-cartier-ideal], and there is a supported Ext class $\kappa\in\operatorname{Ext}^2(\Delta_*A_P,A_W(1))$ with SupportedKummerBoundary [lem-asd-ordinary-supported-kummer]. For either projection $p$, let $J_p:Rp_*A_W(1)[2]\to Rr_{P,*}A_{\mathbf P^1_P}(1)[2]$ be the canonical transport through its projective-line chart, and let $\alpha_p$ be the pasted constant unit [lem-amb-p1-diagonal-integrals]. There is a morphism $\beta_p:A_P\to A_P(1)[2]$ such that $\alpha_p\,Rp_*(\delta_\kappa)\,J_p=\beta_p\,u_P+h_c$, where $u_P$ is the twisted unit and $h_c$ the Chern adjunct [def-asd-ordinary-finite-p1-arrows]. No splitting, trace, or integral identity is assumed.

theorem ordinaryFiniteP1_diagonal_chern_components (N : ℕ) (hN : 0 < N)
    (A : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing A] [Finite A] (hA : (N : A) = 0)
    (t : OrdinaryFiniteTwistTransport A N hA)
    (S : Scheme.{u}) (hS : IsUnit (N : Γ(S, ⊤)))
    (hP : IsUnit (N : Γ(ProjectiveLine S, ⊤)))
    (hPP : IsUnit (N : Γ(ProjectiveLine (ProjectiveLine S), ⊤)))
    (hW : IsUnit (N : Γ(pullback (ProjectiveLine S ↘ S) (ProjectiveLine S ↘ S), ⊤)))
    (c : ordinaryFiniteUnit A (ProjectiveLine (ProjectiveLine S)) ⟶
      (ordinaryFiniteLine A N hA (ProjectiveLine (ProjectiveLine S)))⟦(2 : ℤ)⟧)
    (hc : ordinaryFiniteP1ChernSpec A N hA (ProjectiveLine S) hPP c) :
    ∃ hI : (pullback.diagonal (ProjectiveLine S ↘ S)).ker.IsInvertible,
      ∃ κ : Ext
        ((lowerStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) (pullback.diagonal (ProjectiveLine S ↘ S))).obj
          (ordinaryFiniteConstant A (ProjectiveLine S)))
        (Scheme.finiteEtaleTateLine
          (pullback (ProjectiveLine S ↘ S) (ProjectiveLine S ↘ S)) N A hA) 2,
        SupportedKummerBoundary A N hA (pullback.diagonal (ProjectiveLine S ↘ S))
          hI hW κ ∧
        ∀ a : Bool, ∃ β : ordinaryFiniteUnit A (ProjectiveLine S) ⟶
              (ordinaryFiniteLine A N hA (ProjectiveLine S))⟦(2 : ℤ)⟧,
            ordinaryFiniteP1DiagonalSupportedMap A N hA S a κ ≫
              ordinaryFiniteP1DiagonalChartMap A N hA t S hS a =
            β ≫ ordinaryFiniteP1Unit A N hA t (ProjectiveLine S) hP +
              ordinaryFiniteP1ChernPushforward A N hA (ProjectiveLine S) c
